 About the match
 On this page you can find the Al Riyadh vs Al-Qadsiah match lineup for Saudi Pro League — Round 12 - First Leg, on Thursday 29-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Al Riyadh lines up in a 4-4-2 led by Borjan, while Al-Qadsiah sets up in a 3-5-2 led by Casteels. Al Riyadh is led by head coach Maurício Dulac, while Al-Qadsiah is managed by Brendan Rodgers. The match is played at Prince Faisal bin Fahd Stadium.
